rootLines.reason: Upstream's `tsc --noEmit` (npm run check) type checks every packages/*/src from source through `paths`. Without these entries an import of one pi-effect package from another resolves to `dist/*.d.ts`, which exists only after a build. Two wildcard lines cover every package named @gunta/pi-<directory> and its `testing` subpath. They are the first entries of `paths`, so they are pure additions and upstream appending entries does not conflict. The `testing` line comes first: both patterns share the prefix `@gunta/pi-`, TypeScript takes the first pattern of equal prefix length, and `@gunta/pi-*` would otherwise match `@gunta/pi-x-effect/testing` and miss. Every other subpath one pi-effect package imports from another has its own exact line, for the same reason: `paths` allows one wildcard, so no pattern can cover `<package>/<subpath>`.
